test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that changes the form of narration in the following sentence.

Rohan said, “I didn’t tell any lie to anyone.”

options.text: Rohan said that he had not told any lie to anyone.
Rohan said that I had not told any lie to anyone.
Rohan said that I did not tell any lie to anyone.
Rohan said that he did not tell any lie to anyone

solution:
The correct answer is **Option (1).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in **Direct Speech**. As per the given question, we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• The given question is an assertive sentence and in the simple past tense.
 
• The process of conversion is as follows:
 
• The conjunction** 'that' **will be added, and **comma** and **inverted** commas will be removed.
 
• Since the reporting speech is in the **simple past tense**, a backshift in tense will occur.
 
• Hence, the past simple **"didn't tell"** becomes past perfect **"had not told" **in indirect speech.
 
• **'I' **will be changed into **'he'** because the first-person pronouns are changed according to the subject of the reporting verb.

Therefore, the correct answer is ***"Rohan said that he had not told any lie to anyone."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes in indirect speech:-

 
 

 Direct Speech
 Indirect Speech
 
 

 
 
Simple Present 

 (Subject + V1 + Object)

 
 Simple Past 

 (Subject + V2 + Object)
 
 

 Present Continuous 

 (Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object)
 Past Continuous 

 (Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object)
 
 

 Present Perfect 

 (Subject + has/have + V3 + Object)
 Past Perfect 

 (Subject + had + V3 + Object)
 
 

 Simple Past 

 (Subject + V2 + Object)
 Past Perfect 

 (Subject + had + V3 + Object)
 
 

 Past Continuous 

 (Subject + was/were + V1 + ing + Object)
 Past Perfect Continuous 

 (Subject + had been + V1 + ing + Object)
 
 

 Simple Future 

 (Subject + will/shall + V1 + Object)
 Present Conditional 

 (Subject + would + V1 +Object)
 
 

 Future Continuous 

 (Subject + will/shall + V1 + ing + Object)
 Conditional Continuous 

 (Subject + would + be + V1 + ing + Object)
